# Game room / Visual sources

The Game page is ChefZC's personal fan showcase, not an official game service.

## Official imagery

- `fh6-keyart.jpg`: Forza Horizon 6 official key art, sourced from https://forza.net/forzahorizon6.
- `fh6-tokyo.webp`: official Tokyo night race image, same source.
- `fh6-drive.webp`: official GR GT city image, same source.
- `nba2k27-cover.jpg`: NBA 2K27 Standard Edition cover featuring Victor Wembanyama, from https://newsroom-anz.2k.com/resources/nba-2k27-standard-edition.
- `f1-2026/ferrari-sf26.webp`, `mclaren-mcl40.webp`, `mercedes-w17.webp`: official Formula 1 2026 launch galleries for the Ferrari SF-26, McLaren MCL40 and Mercedes W17, including their real sponsors and liveries. The matching SVG marks come from Formula 1's current team pages. `f1-logo.svg` is the Formula 1 mark mirrored by Wikimedia Commons from the official brand. Exact asset URLs and hashes are in `sources.json`.

The FH6 and NBA files were retrieved on 2026-09-20; the F1 files on 2026-09-26. All are preserved from the listed source URLs without retouching the cars, sponsors or marks. Layout uses CSS sizing/cropping. These are promotional images, not screenshots from ChefZC's play sessions. Game artwork, logos, names and trademarks remain with their respective owners and are excluded from any repository code licence.

## Original presentation

The controller ticket, Tokyo typography, animated route, F1 pop-art blocks, start lights, speed lines, car selection transitions, glass frame, court drawing, decorative basketball, RGB lighting and data layouts were authored for this website with SVG and CSS. Decorative motion is not game telemetry. There are no fabricated scores, wallet balances, player ratings or completion percentages.

## 中文

本页是 ChefZC 的个人游戏展区。F1 25 的 Ferrari、McLaren、Mercedes 2026 赛车图与车队徽标来自 Formula 1 官方图集和车队页面，F1 标志由 Wikimedia Commons 镜像；FH6 的三张图像来自 Forza 官方网站；NBA 2K27 封面来自 2K 官方新闻资料。图像与商标归各自权利人所有，不属于代码许可，也不是 ChefZC 的个人游戏截图。原图地址、下载大小和校验值见 `sources.json`。

手柄票券、东京字牌、道路动画、玻璃框、球场线稿、装饰篮球和 RGB 灯光由本网站单独设计。动画是视觉装饰，不代表游戏实时数据；未核实的余额、总评与完成率不展示。
